tokens.name: fg-100
tokens.usage: Figma fg/100. Primary text, headings, the logo. 19.6:1 on `bg-primary` in both themes.

tokens.name: fg-75
tokens.usage: Figma fg/75. Strong secondary text. 9.6:1 on white, 11.2:1 on the dark ground.

tokens.name: fg-60
tokens.usage: Figma fg/60. Secondary body copy. 5.4:1 on white, 7.3:1 on the dark ground.

tokens.name: fg-50
tokens.usage: Figma fg/50. Captions, subtitles, intro lines, header meta and the footer. 3.8:1 on white, 5.3:1 dark (the HTML renders it stronger; see Colour).

tokens.name: fg-30
tokens.usage: Figma fg/30. Decorative and disabled text; never reading copy (2.1:1 on white).

tokens.name: fg-25
tokens.usage: Figma fg/25. De-emphasised numerals: page and index numbers, oversized digits. 1.8:1 on white, so display sizes only (the HTML renders it stronger; see Colour).

tokens.name: fg-20
tokens.usage: Figma fg/20. Strong dividers and inactive marks.

tokens.name: fg-10
tokens.usage: Figma fg/10. Dividers, table rules and subtle outlines.

tokens.name: fg-5
tokens.usage: Figma fg/5. Subtle surface tint: image placeholders, tinted cards, chart panels. Text on it uses `fg-100`.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Figma fg/muted. Solid navy for metadata: 3.1:1 on white (24px and up, or non-text), 8.6:1 on the dark ground.

tokens.name: bg-primary
tokens.usage: Figma bg/primary. Slide ground: white on light slides, black/100 (#010716) on dark slides.

tokens.name: bg-secondary
tokens.usage: Figma bg/secondary. A barely-there wash over the ground (5%).

tokens.name: bg-overlay-50
tokens.usage: Figma bg/overlay-50. Scrim at 50% over imagery, behind text on photos.

tokens.name: bg-overlay-25
tokens.usage: Figma bg/overlay-25. Scrim at 25% over imagery.

tokens.name: bg-overlay-10
tokens.usage: Figma bg/overlay-10. Scrim at 10% over imagery.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Figma border/default. Control and divider strokes.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: Figma accent/primary. Mint, the signature accent: one deliberate moment per slide. Identical in both themes. 11:1 on the dark ground; 1.9:1 on white, so on light slides use it for fills, marks and scribbles, never small text.

tokens.name: accent-dark
tokens.usage: Figma accent/dark. Accent as ink on light slides (deep petrol-teal, 8.4:1 on white); mint on dark slides.

tokens.name: accent-surface
tokens.usage: Figma accent/surface. Accent panel: mint tint on light slides (`fg-100` on it is 17:1), deep petrol-teal on dark (white on it is 8.4:1).

styles.name: TextXS
styles.usage: Figma Base/TextXS. Fine print, chart axis labels, footnotes.

styles.name: TextSM
styles.usage: Figma Base/TextSM. Small labels, legends, tags, dense table cells.

styles.name: TextMD
styles.usage: Figma Base/TextMD. Body in dense layouts, table cells; in `fg-50` it is the header meta and the footer.
styles.sample: Weekly steering with the client's product owners.

styles.name: TextLG
styles.usage: Figma Base/TextLG. Card body and list copy.

styles.name: TextXL

styles.name: Heading6

styles.name: Heading3

styles.name: Heading2

styles.name: Heading1

styles.name: Title

styles.name: Display
styles.usage: Figma Title/Display. One huge word or numeral as the whole slide.

spacing.note: Figma Sizes collection (2–100). Use these for every gap and padding. Slides use literal px on a 1920×1080 canvas; never viewport units.

tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, heading padding.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: space-32

tokens.name: space-40

tokens.name: space-48

tokens.name: radius-9
tokens.usage: Figma radius/9.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Figma radius/full. Pills and circles: chips, avatars, round badges.
